name: warp
description: Pure functional event-driven devkit. Event -> Gate -> Stream -> StreamLog, plus Axiom as an enforced primitive and a unified dispatch (exact-cache / pre-generation-filter / population / cascade / axiom-gate / score-retain / escalate). v1.4 adds: canonicalization pipeline, fuzzy pre-generation reuse (opt-in), population lifecycle control (decay/pruning/dedup), two-stage generation, gate fusion, axiom cost weighting, and a structural delta cache. Zero dependencies, zero coupling to any consuming project.
author: James Brooks
decoupling_rule: warp/core and warp/dispatch import nothing outside warp/. Consuming projects import warp and supply adapters via Stream.hook().
changelog_note: v1.4 additions are opt-in and default OFF except decay/pruning being available at zero rate by default (i.e. a no-op unless configured) — existing v1.1.0 callers see zero behavior change. See dispatch/benchmark.js section 4 for real measurements; the original v1.4 patch doc's '10x-35x cheaper / 15x-50x faster' claims were not benchmarked against anything and are not repeated here. v1.5.0 (James, upload emergence-6): adds firstSuccessPromotionPolicy and a top-level index.js. Forked into Nexus over 1.4.0 additively — Nexus keeps its Stream ring/SSE, StreamLog levels and larger dispatch, which the upload lacks. v2.0.0 (EM2): WARP 2 beside 1.x — Link, Expectation, Ledger, Engine in core/; adapters/siso-gates.js records 1.x in a WARP 2 ledger; adapters/emerge-field.js puts Emerge's constraints first. core/ still imports nothing outside warp/.
